1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de pequeño tamaño, con aletas radiadas, de forma casi redonda, aplastado y ancho de abdomen, cola larga en forma de brocha, escamas de color gris y castaño en hexágonos alternados e irregulares, cabeza y boca pequeñas, y ojos grandes, saltones, de color rojizo; su carne es apreciada. Ostraciidae; Lactophrys spp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish of small size, with radiated fins, almost round in shape, flattened and broad abdomen, long tail in the form of a brush, scales of gray and brown color in alternating and irregular hexagons, small head and mouth, and large, bulging, reddish-colored eyes; its flesh is prized. Family Ostraciidae; genus Lactophrys spp.
